info.heralizcasino.caisse:
Caps are found on the map (loot containers). Exchange them here for items (red buttons).
Prices are set by the server.
info.heralizcasino.rotten:
Sit down, choose your bet, then SPIN. 35 lines: 3 or more identical symbols from the leftmost reel.
WILD replaces other symbols.
MUTATION: respins where some symbols turn into clowns or WILDs (top banner).
3 MAD SCIENTIST = 10 free spins full of mutations. 3 TOTAL INVASION = 10 free spins where mutations stay until the end!
BONUS: buy the free spins directly.
info.heralizcasino.tableau_gagnants: Ranking of the biggest wins in a single game (with the machine), and the casino record.
info.heralizcasino.tableau_perdants: Ranking of the players who lost the most caps (bets minus winnings).
info.heralizcasino.tableau_parieurs: Ranking of the players who bet the most caps in total.
info.heralizcasino.portes_olympe:
Sit down, choose your bet, then SPIN. No lines: 8 or more identical symbols anywhere on the grid win.
Winning symbols explode and the others fall (cascade): you keep winning as long as there are combinations.
Zeus orbs (x2 to x500): at the end of a winning cascade, their values add up and multiply the win.
4 or more ZEUS = 15 free spins: multipliers add up and never go back down. 3 ZEUS during the bonus = +5 spins.
BONUS: buy the free spins directly.
info.heralizcasino.souffle_loup:
Sit down, choose your bet, then SPIN. 243 ways to win: 3 or more identical symbols on consecutive reels from the left, anywhere on each reel; the WOLF (reels 2 to 4) replaces cards and pigs, never hats or saws.
6 or more HATS = 6 FREE SPINS: each triggering hat places a straw frame. During the spins, each hat creates a frame or upgrades it: straw › wood › brick (on a brick, it builds elsewhere). 3 hats at once = 1 extra spin. At the end, frames become houses and the wolf blows them down: each one reveals its win (caps, MINI, MINOR, MAJOR, GRAND, or a wheel spin for a brick).
3 or more SAWS = THE WHEEL: SAWS (they race to the right and place frames), MEGA HAT (2×2, 3×3 or 5×3), MANSION (all brick), jackpots, or SUPER WHEEL. 2 blue saws + 1 GOLDEN SAW = straight to the SUPER WHEEL: the machine expands to 5 × 6 for SUPER SAWS, SUPER MEGA HAT or SUPER MANSION, otherwise MAJOR, GRAND or SUPER JACKPOT.
BONUS: buy a wheel spin directly.
info.heralizcasino.la_niche:
Sit down, choose your bet, then SPIN. 20 fixed lines, left to right: 3 or more identical symbols from the leftmost reel.
WILD (the doghouse, reels 2 to 4): always x2 or x3, it replaces every symbol except the paw. Multipliers of wilds on the same line ADD UP (x2 + x3 = x5).
3 PAWS (reels 1, 3 and 5) = 7 FREE SPINS and 2 times the bet right away.
Multihold free spins: 4 grids, the first open, the other three padlocked (top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right). Paws only land on the last open grid (amber border): 3 paws there break the next grid's padlock, which gets a copy of all its sticky wilds (same cells, same multipliers), +1 to +3 spins, and spins at once.
Wilds landing during the bonus stay stuck until the end. Each grid pays its 20 lines separately: its win shows in its banner.
BONUS: buy the free spins directly.
info.heralizcasino.plinko:
Choose the price of a ball and how many to drop, then DROP.
Each ball bounces off the pegs and falls into a basket: its bet is multiplied by the basket's number.
The edges pay big but are rare; the center returns less than the bet.
info.heralizcasino.blackjack:
Get close to 21 without going over and beat the dealer.
DEAL places your bet. Then: Hit (one card), Stand, Double or Split.
Face cards are worth 10, the Ace 1 or 11. Everything is played on the table.
info.heralizcasino.crash:
Bet before takeoff. In flight, the multiplier climbs: click CASH OUT before the rocket explodes!
If it explodes first, the bet is lost.
info.heralizcasino.mines:
Choose your bet and the number of mines, then PLAY.
Click the tiles on the table: each gem raises your winnings, a mine makes you lose everything.
CASH OUT whenever you want to keep your winnings.
info.heralizcasino.course:
Choose your bet, then your horse: colored button, board row or directly its lane.
The odds give the win: x3.5 = your bet × 3.5 if your horse wins.
The race starts at the end of the countdown; the camera follows the race.

info.heralizcasino.roulette:
Choose your bet, then click the table: a number, a dozen or a column.
Click several times to bet more. The spin starts at the end of the countdown.
info.heralizcasino.pierre_feuille_ciseau:
Choose your bet, then CHALLENGE: another player accepts with the same bet, and you face each other at the table.
Each round, secretly choose Rock, Paper or Scissors, hands behind your back. At “ROCK-PAPER-SCISSORS”, hands come out and the items are thrown on the table: rock crushes scissors, scissors cut paper, paper covers rock.
The first to win the rounds takes the pot (minus the casino fee). No choice in time = round lost.
info.heralizcasino.bataille_navale:
Choose your bet, then CHALLENGE: another player accepts with the same bet, and each of you sits at one end of the table.
Place your fleet on your board: click a ship then a cell to move it, ROTATE (or R) to turn it, SHUFFLE to reposition everything, then READY.
Taking turns, click a cell on the screen grid to fire. Hit = you go again. The first to sink the whole enemy fleet takes the pot (minus the casino fee).
